title: Python Developer
subtitle: The CS core of a top university degree, plus the engineering jobs demand
summary: Build, test and ship real software in Python - on the same foundations as a top CS graduate.
expert: Designs and owns production Python systems, and understands every layer underneath them - algorithms, memory, the operating system, the network, the database, distributed systems - well enough to stand next to a Stanford, MIT or IIT graduate.

benchmarks.title: Codeforces rating
benchmarks.detail: Specialist (1400+) by the end of Intermediate; Expert (1600+) by the end of Advanced.

benchmarks.title: LeetCode
benchmarks.detail: 300 problems solved, including 50 hard, each with stated complexity.

benchmarks.title: University labs passed
benchmarks.detail: CMU 15-213 malloc lab; three MIT 6.1810 xv6 labs; MIT 6.5840 Raft lab test suite.

benchmarks.title: Production proof
benchmarks.detail: A deployed service with CI/CD and monitoring; a package on PyPI; a merged open-source pull request.

benchmarks.title: Defended out loud
benchmarks.detail: Explain any project's design choices for 30 minutes under questioning - the same way top programmes run viva and design reviews.
